registration.evidence_scope: NEW retrospective reconstruction; 2022-2025 and 2026 Week 6 already exposed; no untouched historical confirmation

archive.population: every original archived row; invalid bindings, absent probabilities and unsupported targets retained with explicit reasons
archive.timing: original local pregame capture; remote publication and provider original source publication unverified

method_selection_source.rule: freeze the existing development-selected method per target, add recent and pooled; no selection or tuning from Week 6 comparisons

unsupported.anytime_td: archive expected counts are not probabilities; original probability binding unavailable; no scoring invented
unsupported.fantasy_ppr: exact lab training outcomes unsupported; retain baseline rows and abstain lab forecasts

training.fit_cutoff: all training labels outcome_available_utc strictly before common archive cutoff, which precedes every included game
training.feature_builder: unchanged nfl_lab.features.build_features; target outcomes stripped before inference
training.availability: current-vintage reconstructed history; assumed kickoff + 7 days; no claim of authenticated historical source availability
training.identity: exact cached Sleeper/GSIS binding only; ambiguous/unlinked players use explicit position-prior cold starts; never name-match
training.game_binding: archive game/team/kickoff/capture clocks must match completed ESPN schedule; available NFLverse schedule tuples cross-checked

evaluation.matching: same archived player/game/target and identical actuals; report pairwise and five-method common support, preserve all source-eligible rows
evaluation.uncertainty: paired game-cluster MAE differences descriptive; one-week cluster inference unavailable; no independence claim across targets
evaluation.missingness: missing rare counts and exact PPR remain missing; played zero and DNP/unknown remain distinct
evaluation.forbidden: no Week 8+ outcomes, method tuning, original pooled-YPA reproduction claim, frozen rec-window writes, deployment or promotion

registration.publication: aggregate derived report and code/config only; raw sources and row-level forecasts/outcomes remain local ignored artifacts
registration.promotion: disabled; one exposed week is descriptive and cannot qualify production

manifest.availability: current-vintage; assumed kickoff+7d; local original pregame baselines only, no authenticated remote publication
